limitations: GO is for one bounded CPU measurement. Actual material quality, resources and source preservation remain unmeasured until that single run finishes; this is not permission to bypass a failed phase-one result.
The 1.5GiB working-data allowance is a conservative code allocation projection, not a measured peak. Unchanged supervisor ceilings and live floors remain authoritative.

Geometric rear-X/negative-X strata do not establish occlusion or visibility; brick and foliage nominations are not full semantic segmentation. Passing bounded samples would not establish exhaustive continuous-field equivalence or arbitrary-viewer quality.

Any required material failure must classify the missionBLOCKED and stop before full-export admission, export, import or rendering. A passing phase one still requires separately reviewed full-export admission within the authorised mission.
